breakdown.description: The prescribed global x-directed shear traction is replaced by a boundary-normal pressure on the slope
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the load should be a horizontal shear traction, not a normal pressure. The generated specification states to 'Apply a uniform horizontal shear traction t = (2000, 0) Pa acting in the global x‑direction on the sloping edge... (inward normal direction is not used)'. This directly corrects the error and aligns with the ground truth.
